sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Given to the special accounts participating in the 2023 Streamer Challenge.
- All items attributed to content creators which are required for the quest Collector cannot be put into the container, with the exception of Gingy keychain.
- Otherwise, can fit:
  - Document case
  - Dogtag case
  - Injector case
  - Key tool
  - Keycard holder case
  - S I C C organizational pouch
  - Simple wallet
  - Loot
  - Provisions
  - Meds
  - Keys, Keycards & Maps
  - Weapon mods (Besides magazines, special scopes and some mounts)
  - Ammo & paper ammo boxes
  - Currency
  - Armbands
  - Earpieces
  - Vanity Face cover
  - Vanity Headwear
  - Vanity Eyewear
  - Melee weapons
  - Special equipment (Besides repair kits)
